# Section 4 — PivotTables

*PivotTables are marked partly on presentation: label your rows/columns clearly and set the right aggregation (Average, Sum, or Count). Your final workbook must leave every requested result visible. Clearly label and highlight the cells that support your written answers. If a question requires a second view, create a second PivotTable or worksheet rather than changing a view that you still need as an answer.*
